reason: Counterexample. The unit sphere of an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space is norm closed but an orthonormal sequence converges weakly to 0 outside it, and the published weak-closure computation identifies the limit set as the closed unit ball; convexity in the weak-closure lemma is essential. Sources [T] Section 13.2 and [MA] Chapter 2 Section 2. Re-recorded because an upstream citation changed; content unchanged.
